Order 10/10/2024
1.

The present writ petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
"(i) By any writ, order or direction quash and set aside the Chargesheet No. 146 filed on 14.08.2019 qua the Petitioner/Ex- Husband in FIR No. 213/2019, dated 17.05.2019 lodged at Police Station Ratanada, District Jodhpur, for offences under sections 498A, 406 and 323 of The Indian Penal Code, 1860 along with subsequent and consequential proceedings against the Petitioner/Ex- Husband.
(ii) By any writ, order or direction, set aside the order dated 23.05.2023 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jodhpur District.
(iii) By any writ, order or direction, set aside the orders dated 21.07.2022 and 14.05.2024 passed by the learned District and Sessions Judge, Jodhpur District.

sentences.text: (iv) By any writ, order or direction, direct the Respondent No.2/ Father of Respondent No.2 to return the amount of Rs. 2,50,000/- (Two Lakh Fifty Thousand only) to the Petitioner with penal interest for the period of 12 (twelve) years and 07 (seven) months.

(v) By any writ, order or direction, impose criminal action/cost upon the Respondent No.2 and her conspirators for misleading the courts, [2024:RJ-JD:41586] (2 of 2) [CRLW-1376/2024] causing immense injury to the petitioner and for committing an abuse of law for the stated facts."
2.

At the very outset, learned Public Prosecutor submits that the present writ petition is not maintainable as the remedy to challenge the orders impugned herein is under Section 528 of BNSS (corresponding Section 482 of Cr.P.C.).
3.
In view of the aforesaid, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the criminal writ petition with liberty to file appropriate petition in accordance with law.
Pending application, if any, stands disposed of.
